newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ventura County Community College.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ventura County Community College.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed or facsimile bids will be received by Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., the Financial Advisor, acting on behalf of the Ventura County Community College District, County of Ventura, State of California (the District''), for the purchase of $12,000,000*
principal amount of Ventura County Community College
District, County of Ventura, California 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes at the hour of 10:30 A.M., Pacific Daylight Time, on

at the offices of Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, facsimile no. (415) 896-0210. In the event that no bid is awarded, the County and the District will receive bids each successive business day at the same time and location until such time as a bid is awarded or the County and the District determine to withdraw sale of the Notes. An Official Statement and an Official Notice of Sale relating to the Notes will be furnished upon request to the Financial Advisor at (415) 281-8556.
